english_gloss: Emergency - go to the hospital right now
what_it_must_convey: Go now, not later. Do not wait, do not finish what you are doing. The urgency must be unmistakable to an older rural patient hearing it once.
must_not_say: Do not name a diagnosis or a condition. The system predicts urgency only. Do not promise a treatment or an outcome. Do not say what is wrong with them.

english_gloss: Needs to see a doctor today
what_it_must_convey: Today, but not this minute. It is serious enough not to leave until tomorrow, and the difference from the first sentence must be audible.
must_not_say: Do not name a diagnosis. Do not imply it is an emergency, and do not imply it can wait until a convenient time.

what_it_must_convey: They will be seen, and it is safe to wait for a normal appointment. It must not sound dismissive: the person came with a real worry.
must_not_say: Do not say there is nothing wrong. The system assessed URGENCY, not whether they are ill. Do not discourage them from returning if things change.

english_gloss: Emergency - go to the hospital right now
what_it_must_convey: Go now. Must be unmistakable read once on a small screen, possibly aloud by someone else.
must_not_say: No diagnosis. No promised outcome. Do not soften it to fit the character limit.

english_gloss: Needs to see a doctor today
what_it_must_convey: Today, not this minute. The difference from CRITICAL must survive being read as a text message.
must_not_say: No diagnosis. Must not read as an emergency, must not read as optional.

what_it_must_convey: They have a place and it is safe to wait. Must not sound dismissive.
must_not_say: Do not say nothing is wrong. Do not discourage returning if things change.
